replacement_spec.body: The act of comparing a quantity to a standard unit, making magnitude explicit and comparable. The parameters are the quantity, the unit, and the standard of comparison; it persists through the continued use of the unit and the physical or conventional instruments that embody it. Measurement is the concrete application of number to the world — the bridge between abstract counting and quantified reality. Distinct from number (the abstract system of units) and from counting (enumeration of discrete items) — measurement handles continuous magnitudes.
